steps.staff: Music is written on a staff: five lines with four spaces between them. Notes sit on the lines or in the spaces, and the higher a note sits, the higher it sounds. These notes climb one step at a time: line, space, line…
steps.trebleClef: The curly sign at the start is the treble clef, or G clef: its curl wraps around the second line from the bottom, and the note on that line is {g}. The right hand usually plays from this staff.
steps.landmarks: Three landmark notes help you find all the others: middle {c} on a short extra line below the staff (a ledger line), {g} on the clef’s line, and the higher {c5} in the third space.
steps.findLandmarks: Play the three landmarks: middle {c}, {g} and the higher {c5}.
steps.quizLandmarks: Now read them from the staff: play each note you see.
